title: AUTO-03 INTENT envelope (se.intent/1)
description: Explicit, structured, versioned intent contract produced by AUTO-03 (`se intent --json`). READ-ONLY envelope: validates and normalizes an explicit intent (objetivo, contexto/proyecto, alcance, restricciones, criterio de éxito). It is never persisted as a record; it is an ephemeral derived view. Compatible with — and does not extend — ADR-0021 (no PLAN record/schema/runtime; the PLAN remains the implicit TASK set plus gates G2/G3).

contract.description: Contract identifier for this envelope format

status.description: Validation/normalization status of the explicit intent

objective.description: The goal the project must achieve (objetivo)

scope.description: Statement of what is in/out of scope (alcance)

restrictions.description: Constraints and restrictions on how work may be carried out (restricciones)

success_criteria.description: Observable criteria that define success (criterio de éxito)

errors.description: Validation errors found while normalizing the explicit intent

source.description: Traceability of how this intent was obtained (explicit file, objective id, ...)
